title: DDL and Schema Management
description: Modify database structure with ALTER TABLE, manage schemas with CREATE/ALTER SCHEMA, rename objects, drop database objects, and create synonyms for abstraction.
whatYouLearn: How to modify table structure with ALTER TABLE to add, alter, or drop columns
How to create and manage schemas with CREATE SCHEMA and ALTER SCHEMA
How to rename tables and indexes safely
How to drop databases, tables, views, indexes, and triggers
How to create synonyms to simplify object names and enable seamless renames
